notes.title: Leaderboards, Linux and Controller Support, with Tons of Improvements!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

Firstly, we wanted to thank you all for the great reception to our last update - we're super glad you're enjoying Transmogrify! We're back now with a new major update - so check out what we've been working on below! And, as part of the Steam Summer Sale, [b]we're launching a 50% discount starting today[/b] - be sure to tell your friends!!

Now, onto the update:

[list]
[*] One of the biggest announcements for this update is the inclusion of [b]speedrunning leaderboards[/b]! Fancy yourself a speedrunner? You can now track the time it takes you to complete Transmogrify, and compete against others for the quickest time! 

[*] Come chat in our community [url=https://discord.gg/XREjnUys6R]Discord[/url] for the latest tips & tracks to up your speed. 

[*] Alongside our leaderboard addition, we're also adding Linux support to Transmogrify. Make sure to let any of your friends on Linux know - it would help us out a ton!

[*] We added new music tracks and adjustments to lots of existing tracks. A great soundtrack is now even better!

[*] We also overhauled our game controller support. Using a controller or Steam Deck should be vastly smoother now.

[*] Finally - and, as always, we've included a plethora of level design fixes, quality of life improvements and bug fixes. You can see the full breakdown of changes below:

[list]

[*] Spike trap timings were fixed.
[*] Leaderboards!
[*] Fixed a bug where we could get stuck underneath certain boxes
[*] Fixed an issue where we could moonwalk off ledges
[*] Added destructible props sounds
[*] Adjusted cutscene SFX routing
[*] Fixed a bug where players get stuck on blocks in World 1 Level 20
[*] World 3 Level 16 cutscene is now skippable
[*] World 4 Level 1 cutscene camera bug fixed
[*] World 2 Level 14 cutscenes bug fixes
[*] Improved space where you gain the grab powerup
[*] Various improvements to World 2 levels where you could softlock or get stuck
[*] Addict enemies no longer get stunlocked by grenades
[*] Lasers don't randomly collide with the background anymore.
[*] Rolling Slimes now correctly activate buttons
[*] Fixed teleporter exit offsets
[*] Significant music overhaul for many tracks
[*] Powerups don't accidentally persist across levels
[*] Intro cutscene adjustments
[*] Game Controller improvements
[*] Checkpoints now set Jetpack fuel to the maximum to avoid awkward spots on respawn.
[*] Fixed visual layering issues with the player.
[*] Music transitions for boss fights now work properly
[*] Grace correctly faces the intended direction for cutscenes
[*] Numerous improvements across all levels, layouts, and puzzles.
[*] Many, many bug fixes and improvements from user feedback.
[/list]
[/list]
That's all from us for now folks! As always, thanks very much for playing.

- The Transmogrify Team

notes.title: Game Update #1: Level Design Revamp is OUT NOW - as well as 45% off!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

We hope everyone's loving the game so far. As we launch our first major update to Transmogrify - we wanted to fill you in on some of the details of what we've been working on. And, to celebrate our first-ever update, we're announcing a [b]sale of 45% off - starting today[/b]!

Now, onto the update:

- The crux of the update is our level design changes. Based on your guys' feedback (we're always eager to hear what you think -- feel free to come and chat with us in our [url=https://discord.gg/XREjnUys6R]Discord[/url]!), we've improved every level in the game- adjusting the difficulty of many, and adding a whole bunch of gameplay, aesthetic, and quality of life changes to all of them.

[img]https://playtransmogrify.com/static/4c45ad0e39a83ea78ae0aae2c5912bd0/14010/bugmom_dodge_1_edited.png[/img]

- Alongside our level design changes, we've added an array of brand-new Steam Achievements to the game. We had a blast making them, and we really hope you enjoy them. And, if you're looking for some hints as to some of the hidden achievements... Maybe our [url=https://discord.gg/XREjnUys6R]Discord [/url] could help you out...

[img]https://playtransmogrify.com/static/bac607bf4eda97f80e71063e63b7c1fa/14010/grenade_launcher%201_edited.png[/img]

That's all from us for now folks! As always, thanks very much for playing,

- The Transmogrify Team

Nitty gritty patch notes for version 1.5.0 below:

* Powerups no longer fall through the floor sometimes
* Music responds to menu sliders appropriately now instead of muting at times
* World Select menu now has sounds and ambiences
* Failing a Grab attempt no longer triggers if it is locked.
* Cancelling Grab button added to the Joypad Menu
* Falling debris no longer causes rare crashes
* UI now displays multiple gun mods correctly when you die
* Fixed Pause Menu state persistence
* Transmogs spawning initially in a level now transmogrify faster
* Mirrors left on the floor no longer kill you after their corresponding Psychics transmogrify.
* Transmogs can no longer be carried back to the Start Menu, although this was funny.
* Spooky Slime Balls no longer push you through walls randomly.
* Voice lines now queue properly in World 4
* Shooting out of a Cannon into another transmog no longer rarely causes crashes.
* Can no longer accidentally Grab a Cannon while inside of it.
* Increased alert range on all minibosses
* Bat animations no longer stutter
* Fixed various laser visual issues
* FIxed minor issues with jump pads, doors, buttons, and pulley platforms
* Fixed a long-standing bug where you could transmogrify two enemies at once.
* Powerups now persist correctly when respawning from Chutes
* Repositioned nearly every Grace line in World 4
* Added in-game and Steam Achievements
* You no longer sometimes fall through one-way platforms when pushing a transmog
* Hid debug label on The Boss
* Moving Platform sounds now pause when their movement does
* Added lots of sound effects to the correct buses
* Enemies no longer respawn from Chutes with two health bars
* Can now swap powerups even when max slots are occupied
* Fixed a bug making backpack pickups not autopickup after dropping a backpack.
* Fixed a bug where laser telegraphs were showing up when they shouldn't
* Embiggened the Settings clickable area on the main menu
* Grabbing won't attempt to work on Lurker Trees
* Spooky Slime bullets no longer collide with Glider powerups
* So many bug fixes
* So many level changes

notes.title: Release Date Locked in for April 24th 2023!
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that Transmogrify will finally release to on April 24th, 2023.

Focusing on development and delivering the best possible experience was really important to us. We are happy with where it is at and ready to release.

We believe in our game and are excited to share it with everyone.

The entire Steam page has been revamped, along with the new trailer.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Livestreaming for the Autumn Festival!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We are excited to participate in the Autumn Festival this year, and will be livestreaming on October 9th from 4pm (16:00) until 6pm (18:00) EST (UTC).

We will be playing levels that are included in the demo, closed beta, as well as new content we are testing and polishing, and can even show off some work-in-progress stuff too!

If you're interested in a puzzle platformer that has a unique mechanic, the soul of an old-school platformer, and comes in a modern package, stop by for a bit!

Best,
Andrew and Team Transmogrify

notes.title: Transmogrify demo is available for the Autumn Festival!
notes.content:
We've been hard at work polishing Transmogrify and we're almost done! We could show you, but why not try yourself? 

Face it: instead of simply killing monsters, you've always wanted to transform them in tools, power ups, and structures to solve puzzles at a break-neck pace, in a challenging but fair platformer.

We've been hard at work fulfilling this secret desire of yours. 

What you get in the demo:

- 9 polished levels
- a good dollop of puzzle platforming
- a decent challenge (we're keeping the harder levels for later!)
- a overview of the type of enemies and environments you'll encounter

We're super happy to have a demo out. It's very important to us. We want people to be able to know if they like the game before buying.

We haven't nailed down a release date yet, but we can't wait for you to try the demo, and please, do give us feedback; good or bad, it will help us make the game better. Don't be shy! Wishlist if you like it!

[url=https://www.playtransmogrify.com/]https://www.playtransmogrify.com/[/url]

notes.title: Check out the new trailer, website, and demos!
notes.content:
Hello!

Today we just dropped our new trailer which you can find here on the Steam page.

Team Transmogrify
